observations: I opened assets/panels/07-3.png, main-cast.png and page-07.png and looked at them myself. Meera sits at the reception desk at the left, smiling warmly toward screen-right. Ravi is seen from behind and in partial profile in the right foreground. This keeps the Meera-left, Ravi-right staging from 07-1.

Meera matches her sheet: face traits, braid, blue printed kurta, and the silver bangle on her gesturing right wrist. Her right hand opens toward Ravi's phone. Her left hand rests on the desk. Both match the production notes.

Ravi holds the phone in his left hand, which wears the wristwatch, with the screen angled toward Meera and the reader. The screen shows a calendar card and a person card with blank lines. I found no text. His beard, hair and green shirt match his sheet.

The background shows waiting chairs and three figures seen from behind. On page-07.png the balloon is on the plain upper wall with its tail to Meera. It does not cover her face, her hands or the phone.
